era.neolithic.story: Harvest binds the people to the land.
era.bronze.story: Furnaces and tablets change the measure of power.
era.classical.story: Cities write down what they once kept in memory.
era.medieval.story: A new order grows between walls and monasteries.
era.industrial.story: Machines change the working day and the sky.
era.contemporary.story: Wealth is now measured in rights and services too.
era.information.story: The world grows smaller. Its problems travel with it.
policy.husbandry.tradeoff: More food reserves, greater pressure on health
policy.cloisters.tradeoff: More learning and care, less religious authority
policy.mercantilism.tradeoff: More control of markets, less trade
policy.sanitation.tradeoff: More health, more infrastructure to maintain
policy.welfare.tradeoff: More health and cohesion, more expenditure
policy.transition.tradeoff: More environmental protection, lower short-term profits
policy.habitats.tradeoff: More capacity, greater pressure on resources
event.drought.title: The riverbed emerges
event.drought.body: Pools along the trail are shrinking. Water carriers must walk farther each day.
event.dryHarvest.title: Berries dry on the riverbank
event.dryHarvest.body: Bushes near the water bear little fruit. Stored roots are the camp’s last reserve.
event.winter.title: A long cold season
event.winter.body: Snow has covered the trails. The outlying hearths have food for two nights.
event.grazing.title: Worn pastures
event.grazing.body: The herds reach the fields before their herders.
event.storeroom.title: Granaries past capacity
event.storeroom.body: Sacks left outside attract animals. The council asks for a shared reserve.
event.flood.title: The river changes course
event.flood.body: A flood has moved the riverbed closer to the fields.
event.silt.title: Silted canals
event.silt.body: Water flows where the records say it should not.
event.shortage.title: The price of bread
event.shortage.body: The ovens in the poorest districts will open empty. Merchants have grain, but the harvest meant to repay their loans is still in the fields.
event.soil.title: Exhausted soil
event.soil.body: Output is rising. Fertility is moving the other way.
event.heat.title: An unrelenting summer
event.heat.body: Demand for water outstrips reserves in several regions.
event.split.title: Two fires at camp
event.split.body: A group has left the communal fire. It wants a say.
event.feud.title: A feud between clans
event.feud.body: An old dispute returns as supplies run short.
event.inherit.title: The elders’ place
event.inherit.body: The assembly must choose who will keep the group’s memory.
event.common.title: The granary boundary
event.common.body: One door separates those with a harvest from those who must ask.
event.ledger.title: The debt is written
event.ledger.body: For the first time even an old debt has a good memory.
event.quarrel.title: The assembly divides
event.quarrel.body: Two squares demand to speak for the same city.
event.creed.title: Conflicting calendars
event.creed.body: Villages argue over shared festivals, debts and market days.
event.pamphlets.title: Pamphlets in the squares
event.pamphlets.body: A printed sheet travels through the markets before dawn.
event.strike.title: The workshops fall silent
event.strike.body: Workers ask for time and income in a city used to machine schedules.
event.polarization.title: Two versions of the world
event.polarization.body: Each community hears only the news that confirms its fears.
event.injury.title: Return from the hunt
event.injury.body: The injured return before the hunt. Families ask for help.
event.crowding.title: Houses too close
event.crowding.body: The village grew quickly. Its drains did not.
event.fever.title: Fever in the village
event.fever.body: Homes close one by one. Care takes resources.
event.wells.title: Clouded wells
event.wells.body: The village wonders whether to drink the remaining water.
event.animals.title: Pens and houses
event.animals.body: The most convenient enclosure is closest to the sleeping quarters.
event.roadSickness.title: Illness along the roads
event.roadSickness.body: Towns along the road ask for coordinated care.
event.cityAir.title: Factory air
event.cityAir.body: The factories work at night. So do the doctors.
event.wards.title: Full wards
event.wards.body: The health network has grown more slowly than the population.
event.burnout.title: Always switched on
event.burnout.body: The council hears from citizens who struggle to sleep and meet one another.
event.orbitCare.title: Care at a distance
event.orbitCare.body: The first health convoy lags behind the new habitats.
event.exchange.title: Goods on the trail
event.exchange.body: Neighbouring villages propose exchanging their surplus.
event.weights.title: The right weight
event.weights.body: Every stall uses a different measure, even when it has the same name.
event.clerks.title: The paperwork piles up
event.clerks.body: Two offices record the same harvest. Neither records the waiting.
event.borderTax.title: Tolls on the bridge
event.borderTax.body: The bridge joins the banks. The toll divides them again.
event.credit.title: Promises on credit
event.credit.body: Merchants want guarantees on routes that have grown too long.
event.lobby.title: A factory audience
event.lobby.body: A consortium offers public works in exchange for favourable terms.
event.subsidies.title: Subsidies before the assembly
event.subsidies.body: A new safety net forces the council to choose whom to fund first.
event.servers.title: Who owns the network
event.servers.body: Shared knowledge depends on a handful of private nodes.
event.automationGap.title: Production without wages
event.automationGap.body: The machines produce enough. Incomes follow another rhythm.
event.newHarbor.title: Passage to a new harbour
event.newHarbor.body: The first orbital communities want autonomy and a mutual support compact.
slot.title: Your civilizations
slot.label: Game {n}
slot.error: Local saves could not be accessed.
slot.invalid: This file is not a valid Epoche save.
slot.conflict: This game is open in another tab.
slot.overwrite: Replace the save in this slot?
slot.restart: Start a new civilization in this slot?
genesis.title: Genesis
genesis.seedHint: Reuse the seed and the same choices to generate the same world.
genesis.0.body: Before there are peoples, there are stars. Choose how much energy your world’s sky will hold.
genesis.1.body: Water opens routes and separates lands. Your world takes shape.
genesis.2.body: Species learn to share resources or guard them. Their resilience begins here.
genesis.3.body: The first people gather around a fire. Decide what drives them further.
social.title: Social groups
council.title: Council
council.food: Supplies tell us how long we have left to decide.
council.health: The health of our households deserves attention before any new project.
council.social: Listen to those least supportive of reforms. They will feel their cost first.
council.pressure: Growth demands space and supplies this land struggles to provide.
council.ready: We have the conditions for a new age. The choice remains with the Spirit.
council.steady: A decision can wait. Its effects take time.
event.title: Council dilemma
crisis.title: Current crises
chronicle.empty: The civilization’s decisions will appear here.
log.founded: {name} is founded. The Spirit takes up residence.
log.dark: The civilization enters a dark age.
log.split: The civilization divides. The Spirit follows {name}.
log.migrate: The Spirit takes up residence among {name}.
log.dormant: The Spirit waits. Its culture seeks a revival.
log.extinction: The civilization dies out. Its story becomes Legacy.
log.ending: The civilization completes its journey beyond its own world.
spirit.inherited: Legacy from completed games supports starting Influence.
doctrine.title: Doctrine while away
doctrine.help: The doctrine handles minor decisions while you are away. A major dilemma pauses time.
absence.title: While you were away
absence.stopped: The civilization is waiting for your decision.
outcome.title: A turning point for the civilization
outcome.fragment: Follow one of the new communities
pace.label: Campaign pace
pace.standard.hint: Ages unfold across sessions and time away.
event.spring.title: The first spring
event.spring.body: Foragers found a spring beyond the usual trail.
event.nuts.title: Few nuts
event.nuts.body: Familiar plants yielded less. Households compare their baskets.
event.flocks.title: Flocks over the valley
event.flocks.body: The flocks are passing farther north. Following them means leaving shelter.
event.embers.title: Embers at night
event.embers.body: Keeping the fire alive preserves food and consumes wood.
event.seed.title: Seed for tomorrow
event.seed.body: Some households propose setting the best grain aside for planting.
event.mice.title: Tracks in the granaries
event.mice.body: The village measures its supplies and discovers new guests.
event.creek.title: A narrower stream
event.creek.body: Water barely reaches the fields. The guardians suggest taking turns.
event.saplings.title: The young trees
event.saplings.body: Trees are taking root in abandoned plots. The returning forest divides households.
event.singers.title: Songs at the hearth
event.singers.body: A new story circulates among the fires. The elders want to tell it together.
event.trail.title: Divided trails
event.trail.body: Two groups prefer different routes for the next move.
event.guests.title: Guests at the edge
event.guests.body: A household from far away asks to join the group.
event.shell.title: The shell gift
event.shell.body: An object passed from hand to hand becomes the symbol of a promise.
event.crafters.title: Hands rarely heard
event.crafters.body: The toolmakers want a say in harvest distribution.
event.fences.title: Extra fences
event.fences.body: Two fences have blocked the same path. Households ask for a shared passage.
event.mourning.title: The communal mound
event.mourning.body: Households discuss where to remember those they have lost.
event.repair.title: The meeting hall roof
event.repair.body: The shared shelter leaks. Households argue over who should repair it.
event.smoke.title: Smoke in the shelter
event.smoke.body: The wind has turned. Smoke lingers near the fire.
event.coldwater.title: Cold water
event.coldwater.body: A freezing morning tests the young and those caring for them.
event.caregivers.title: Watching over sleepers
event.caregivers.body: Few people know the care used on the hardest nights.
event.shelters.title: Damp shelters
event.shelters.body: Rain has dampened bedding at the edges of camp.
event.slopes.title: Homes on the slope
event.slopes.body: It is easier to build near the fields. The slope tells a different story.
event.cistern.title: The shared cistern
event.cistern.body: Households ask for simple rules for using the remaining water.
event.shade.title: Shade for workers
event.shade.body: Field shifts have grown longer with the warm season.
event.winterHouses.title: The season indoors
event.winterHouses.body: More people are spending longer under the same roof.
event.marketDay.title: Market day
event.marketDay.body: Neighbouring villages propose a shared day for meeting and trading.
trial.bronze: You have reached the Bronze Age debt ledger.
genesis.waterEffect: Water chance in inland cells away from settlement centres: {chance}%.
slot.promise: Guide one village through the ages. Your decisions change what its descendants can do.
trial.wrongMode: Open this save in its original mode (campaign or study).
hearing.title: Face the transition
hearing.intro: Before entering, decide which loss to bear. Each option shows crises after settlement. At 100 the village dissolves.
hearing.ledgerIntro: The ledger remembers who paid during the winter. Who should bear the next share?
hearing.study: Guided study through the Bronze Age
hearing.warning: You can renegotiate the supplies before entering the next era.
council.hearing: The village can advance. The council must still decide who bears the debt.
log.hearing: The council opens the ledger of losses.
hearing.pickSlot: Choose a slot to replay this world with the same starting conditions.
price.carry.ledger: Collecting the share raises clan tensions by 13. If barter supplies remain, use them to settle families sheltered at the thaw (+3% population).
price.carry: All debts are added to the current crises.
price.seeds: Repay 60 food. For the next era the east field lies fallow and sustenance drops by 2. During the Neolithic, choices worsening the food crisis cost 12 extra points.
price.departure: Repay 70 food. A fifth of the population leaves and tensions rise by 15. If the Bronze ledger opens, you can offer land for their return.
price.isolate: Health crisis −20, tensions +22. A hut stays separate through the Bronze Age; relatives claim a share at the ledger.
price.care: Health crisis −20, food crisis +18. Growers give up one plot through the Bronze Age.
price.levy: Reduce the largest bill by 35. Lose 15% of the population and another crisis rises by 18.
price.condone: Families of the common table give food: food crisis +17, tensions −20. The tradition is consumed.
price.renew: Food crisis +12 now and 18 more in two eras. The table lasts through the Middle Ages.
remedy.returnClan: Give land to the returning clan
price.returnClan: Population +15%, food crisis +15. A plot remains unsown through the Classical era.
remedy.share: Support the relatives of the sick
price.share: Growers give 14 food. The health crisis falls by 12 and welcoming families increases population by 12%.
deferred.winter.2: Crowded shelters will spread illness at the thaw.
hearing.failedCrop: The east field lies fallow. Responses that worsen the food crisis cost 12 additional points, included in the forecast.
winter.trace.0: The common table is founded. In the Bronze Age households can use it to forgive a share.
winter.trace.3: At the thaw you choose how to treat the sick. Supplies beyond the debt feed new families: up to 20% more inhabitants.
price.departure.late: Repay 70 food debt. One in five inhabitants leaves and tensions rise by 15.
hearing.debtDanger: Without a remedy, the {family} crisis reaches 100 at the transition.
